children: CoreWeave is drawing fresh attention from Wall Street after UBS began covering the AI infrastructure provider with a Buy rating and a $120 price target, according to a Wednesday research note.

Analyst Karl Keirstead said demand for computing power remains supportive, while revenue generated from each gigawatt of capacity could rise as GPU pricing improves. He also expects demand from enterprise customers to add to growth alongside AI labs.

The valuation reflects investor caution. Keirstead noted that CoreWeave trades at roughly three times projected 2027 revenue, with concerns focused on leverage and credit exposure. UBS said those risks may be nearing a peak.
Keirstead also pointed to the company's operating track record as a factor that could help it compete with other AI infrastructure providers.

The $120 target is based on 3.8 times expected 2028 sales. CoreWeave faces risks including high debt, questions over the sector's long-term profitability and customer concentration, with three customers accounting for 72% of revenue.

title: CoreWeave Lands Fresh Wall Street Vote of Confidence as UBS Sets $120 Target
